subject: RPC channel: project registration
value: forge:projects/register — request RegisterProjectInput { workspaceDir, name, forgeDir, knowledgeDir }; response RegisterResult { projectId, workspaceId, attachedToExisting, compensated? }

subject: RPC channel: project list (registered-path marker + hero phase data source)
value: forge:projects/list — response ProjectSummary[] ordered by created_at, id; wsPath set feeds the「已注册」marker in directory browser

subject: RPC channel: startup reconciliation pass
value: forge:projects/reconcile — response ReconcileReport { repaired: ReconcileRepair[] (action relinked|recreated), orphans: ReconcileOrphan[] }

subject: RPC channel: directory listing for add-project file browser (canonicalization producer)
value: forge:fs/listDir — entries canonicalized via path.resolve on host side (对账基准)

subject: RPC channels: knowledge browse face (5 channels, search/read-abstract are agent-face only)
value: forge:knowledge/browse (DomainNode[]), forge:knowledge/listEntries (KnowledgeCard[]), forge:knowledge/entryDetail (EntryDetail), forge:knowledge/heat (Map entryId→count), forge:knowledge/sessionRecall (RecallGroup[])

subject: RPC envelope shape (errors in-band, never promise rejection)
value: RpcOk { ok: true, data } | RpcErr { ok: false, error: { code, message, data? } }

subject: Register step ①: ownership precheck = canonical-path equality match on registry.list
value: existing = registry.list().find(ws => ws.path === input.workspaceDir); hit ⇒ attachedToExisting=true, step ② skipped entirely (①→③ only), no compensation ever registered

subject: Register step ②: dsh create (idempotent by canonical path)
value: workspace = await registry.create(input.workspaceDir); failure ⇒ WorkspaceCreateError (ERR_WORKSPACE_CREATE), abort, no compensation needed

subject: Register step ③: app DB write stores registry-returned canonical ws_path
value: withTransaction INSERT INTO projects (id=randomUUID(), workspace_id, ws_path=workspace.path, name, forge_dir, forge_dir_external, knowledge_dir, 0, …); ws_path UNIQUE

subject: Register step ④: compensation gate — attach branch never deletes (ownership protection)
value: registry.delete(workspace.id) runs only when !attachedToExisting; attach-branch write failure throws ProjectWriteError with zero delete calls and zero key-logs

subject: ③ write failure + ④ compensation success ⇒ ProjectWriteError with compensated info
value: ERR_PROJECT_WRITE, data.compensated = { workspaceId, reason: '③ 应用库写入失败（registry.delete 补偿已执行）' }

subject: Error code set (forge + knowledge domains)
value: ERR_WORKSPACE_CREATE | ERR_PROJECT_WRITE | ERR_COMPENSATION | ERR_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND | ERR_INDEX_STALE | ERR_INVALID_KNOWLEDGE_DIR

subject: registry.delete is idempotent no-op on unknown id, preserves directory and logs
value: delete(id) → Promise<boolean>; unknown id ⇒ false, no error (repeat compensation = no-op); 目录与会话日志一律保留

subject: ④ compensation failure key-log entry (app_key_logs)
value: level=error, scope=compensation, message「registry.delete 补偿失败：工作区 … 留存为孤儿——启动对账将提示，不自动删」, data { workspaceId, wsPath, projectId, writeError, deleteError, disposition }

subject: Startup reconciliation: single-direction reference repair keyed by ws_path
value: registry.get(workspace_id); pass iff current.path === row.ws_path; miss ⇒ registry.list().find(ws => ws.path === row.ws_path) ⇒ relinked; not found ⇒ registry.create (idempotent recreate) ⇒ recreated; then UPDATE projects SET workspace_id — never mutates dsh side; orphan = registry entry without projects row, reported + warn log only, never auto-deleted

subject: FACT-TENSION: reconcileAtStartup is channel-exposed only; no auto-invocation found at startup
value: Neither apps/host/src/main.ts, boot code, nor core plugin activation calls reconcileAtStartup; only forge:projects/reconcile channel + web client wrapper exist. Journey 4b/5c startup-reconciliation expectation requires a startup invocation seam (defect signal / design adjudication)

subject: FACT-TENSION: test.setFault vocabulary from journeys is a test-infrastructure contract, not shipped code
value: No setFault/injectFault/faultPoint in shipped code. Unit seams: StubRegistry constructor injection (failCreate/failDelete) + ws_path UNIQUE conflict row seeding; e2e lacks a fault facility. gen-test-scripts must realize ③/④ failure preconditions via these seams or a new harness

subject: Task-list/records dir derivation = {dsh-forge-home}/{flattened canonical path}
value: flatten: normalize dir, drop drive colon, replace path separators with '-'（Z:\project\dsh → Z-project-dsh）; DEFAULT_DSH_FORGE_HOME = '~/.dsh-forge' (display-only in P1, real home injected at assembly)

subject: Register-form default derivation + reselect linkage
value: name = folderNameOf(ws); forgeDir = <ws>\.forge; knowledgeDir = <ws>\.knowledge; relinkWorkspace: untouched fields re-derive on re-pick, touched (hand-edited/browse-picked) fields preserved; 仓内/仓外 = isForgeDirExternal(relative-position check)

subject: Register-form validation issues + confirm gating (web validation-error face)
value: issues: 工作区目录不能为空 / 项目名不能为空 / 文档位置（forge 目录）不能为空 / 需为绝对路径 / 知识库目录不能为空 / 需为绝对路径; 确认 disabled while issues>0; issue rows role=alert per field

subject: Add-project flow phases + cancel/close intents
value: FlowPhase = browser | form | repick | executing | success | failure; closeIntentOf: cancel-points (browser/form/repick) → cancel (clean exit, zero register/compensation); failure → dismiss; executing/success → ignore (Esc/✕/mask unified); beginExecute one-shot guards double-confirm

subject: Add-project success/failure feedback copy
value: success: Tag「注册成功」+ attachedToExisting ?「已挂接既有工作区。」:「已创建新工作区。」, auto-close 1600ms; failure copy branches per ERR_WORKSPACE_CREATE / ERR_PROJECT_WRITE (compensated vs 挂接保护未补偿) / ERR_COMPENSATION / 未预期错误

subject: Shell view state machine (no URL routing)
value: ShellViewState { center: 'session'|'knowledge', rightDock, rightDockPreference, focus {projectId, sessionId} }; show-knowledge ⇒ center=knowledge + rightDock=false (preference kept); show-session ⇒ rightDock = preference ?? false; dockTrackMode: knowledge→hidden, rightDock→expanded|collapsed; both center panes stay mounted (keep-alive, zero unmount); root anchor data-dswf-view / data-dswf-phase

subject: Session panel three tabs, keep-alive switch
value: SessionTabId = chat | trajectory | recall; labels 对话/轨迹/知识召回; three panes always mounted hidden=, switching loses zero state; trajectory = TranscriptEntry time-series (user-message…tool-result, seq asc); recall default EmptyState「本会话暂无召回」

subject: Sidebar session list: dsh ledger live read + row language + placeholders
value: sessions.list ObservableSnapshot via useSyncExternalStore (零缓存零副本); row = StateDot + displayTitle + relative time (刚刚/X 分钟前…); status map pendingInteraction→attention > completed→done > running > running > idle; zero-session placeholder「暂无会话」; skeleton 3 rows when ledger pending; no-projects EmptyState「尚未注册项目」

subject: New-session entry equivalence (button + brand row + session rows)
value: 新会话 button and brand row share aria-label session.new.label and onClick startSession(); session row click = openSession + select-session dispatch; sessionId appear/change ⇒ select-session event ⇒ back to session view

subject: Blank-message send interception mechanism (upstream composer)
value: empty = draft.trim()==='' && no attachments; send button disabled when empty; click guard + input-machine submit() double guard — blank submit produces zero message/roundtrip; focus retention = mechanism side-effect (button disabled, input never blurs), not explicit restore code

subject: Hero empty-state phase derivation + permanent retirement
value: lastReadyCount===0 ⇒ hero (count includes archived — no fall-back to 0 after first registration = permanent retirement); settling transient marker for null count; hero copy h1「以知识资产为核心的研发工作台」CTA「＋ 添加项目」; DOM anchors data-dswf-workbench data-dswf-phase, data-dswf-cta=add-project

subject: Dock tab scope model — visible set = global + current project; FACT-TENSION: no project tabs registered in shipped code
value: DockTabScope {type:global}|{type:project,projectId}; visibleDockTabs filters global || current project; project switch swaps set, switch back restores (derived, no snapshot); M0_DOCK_TABS = [global 'start 开始'] only — project-level tabs require a fixture/preseed seam (journey Setup marks channel as inferred test contract)

subject: Knowledge browse view states + toolbar + domain tree + grid + drawer
value: grid states: skeleton(8 cards)|cards|no-results|empty-library|error (priority error>cards>skeleton>filter?no-results:empty-library); toolbar Input placeholder「搜索关键词…」Esc 清除 + 清除搜索 button; domain tree role=tree rows data-dswf-domain, root row「全部域」clears filter; no-results EmptyState + action「清除过滤」(data-dswf-clear-filters); empty-library EmptyState「尚无知识」naming knowledge dir; drawer close Esc(capture)+✕, body MarkdownDoc variant=body with frontmatter stripped, detail channel forge:knowledge/entryDetail

subject: FACT-TENSION: index rebuild fires only on ZERO index rows (inline awaited); no stale-detect background rebuild
value: silent rebuild only when project has zero knowledge_entries rows, awaited inline inside search/listEntries; digest stored but never compared; web keeps old cards visible (busy) during refetch; explicit rebuildIndex(projectId) otherwise. Journey knowledge-browsing 1c phase ② (grid updates after external dir change) has no automatic trigger in shipped code

subject: search capability: domain-prefix filter + keyword AND + text substring (title/summary only)
value: SearchQuery { projectId, sessionId?, domainPrefix?, keywords?, text?, limit? }; domainPrefix omitted = all domains; prefix match = segment boundary (domain = ? OR LIKE 'prefix/%'); keywords exact case-insensitive AND against entry keywords; text substring vs title AND/OR summary — body never matched nor read; scoring 2×keywords + 2×title + 1×summary

subject: readAbstract returns summary-only abstract, never body
value: ReadAbstractQuery { projectId, sessionId?, entryId } → EntryAbstract { entryId, title, summary, keywords, status, domainPath } — 不含正文; cache-only read; miss ⇒ ERR_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND + warn key-log

subject: Agent-facing tool ids exposed by knowledge plugin
value: knowledge.search (args domain_prefix?/keywords?/text?/limit?, snake_case; zero-hit render hints fallback to grep/glob) and knowledge.read-abstract (arg entry_id required); abstract-first — full body never returned

subject: System-prompt knowledge section registration
value: ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'forge:knowledge', order: 500, text: renderKnowledgeSection(tools) }) — heading '## Project knowledge base', domain depth ≤3 note, 5-step agentic-search flow guidance; session binding via projects config binding table, cwd→projectId; unbound session throws

subject: FACT-TENSION: usage events recorded per tool call × hit (verb ∈ search|read-abstract)
value: knowledge_recall_logs: one row per call × hit entry (call_id uuid groups rows); zero-hit search writes sentinel row (entry_id NULL, hit_count 0); read-abstract writes exactly 1 row; browse/query face writes zero rows. A full chain (search 1 hit + read-abstract) = 2 call groups / 2 entry rows. Journey flywheel pins chain=1 口径 (召回次数/覆盖/热度 +1) — per-call counting would yield 2 (断言失败即缺陷信号, journey invariant)

subject: Heat = per-project COUNT over knowledge_recall_logs grouped by entry_id
value: SELECT entry_id, COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_recall_logs WHERE project_id=? AND entry_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entry_id; card.heat = map value ?? 0; recall tab hit heat falls back to frontmatter_id key after rebuild clears entry refs

subject: Recall tab statistics semantics + UI labels
value: stats.calls = groups.length (COUNT DISTINCT call_id, zero-hit calls count); stats.covered = dedup by identity key entryId→frontmatterId→title; UI renders「召回次数 N」「覆盖知识 N」; groups most-recent-first; heat badges per hit

subject: Knowledge frontmatter contract (required/optional/depth)
value: required: summary, keywords (missing/invalid ⇒ entry skipped from index, counted in IndexReport.skipped); optional: title (default filename), status (default draft), id, authors, updated (default mtime); domain depth ≤3 (directory-derived, over-depth rejected reason domain-depth); keywords must be string[] (empty array legal)

subject: Domain tree = directory-derived, node counts include sub-domain entries
value: deriveDomainPath: dir segments of relPath joined '/'; aggregateDomainTree counts include sub-domain entries (与域前缀过滤同口径); DomainNode { domainPath, label, depth 1..3, entryCount }; only .md files (case-insensitive), dot files/dirs and symlinks excluded

subject: Left rail collapse geometry (official shell-owned)
value: collapsed rail = 56px control bar; expanded clamp 264–420px (default 280); auto-collapse below 1024px viewport; collapse button aria-label toggle.open, shortcut sidebar.left.toggle; product renders rail icons only (data-dswf-sidebar=rail)

subject: Electron main: privileged scheme load, single-instance lock, boot channel
value: BrowserWindow 1440×900 hidden titleBarStyle, ready-to-show→show; loadURL dsh-forge://app/ (privileged scheme proxies to dev/host server); BOOT_CHANNEL 'dsh-forge:boot' → { url, injections }; preload window.dshForge { getBootManifest, invoke } with channel allowlist; requestSingleInstanceLock false ⇒ quit; env DSH_FORGE_USER_DATA / DSH_FORGE_PORT / DSH_FORGE_MATERIALIZE_ONLY; boot watchdog 180s exit(3)

subject: electron-builder NSIS packaging (offline self-sufficient)
value: appId app.dshforge.desktop, productName dsh-forge; win target nsis (oneClick:false, perMachine:false, allowToChangeInstallationDirectory:true, differentialPackage:false, publish:null); shortcuts = NSIS defaults (desktop + start menu on; no explicit keys); asar:false, runtime tree + web-dist + staging-manifest shipped via extraResources — 安装期零网络; per-user install under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs

subject: E2E infrastructure: Playwright _electron, isolation, probes
value: Playwright _electron launch (cwd apps/host); user-data isolation via mkdtemp + DSH_FORGE_USER_DATA + unique port; readiness gate __DSH_BOOT_READY__ → __ModuleLoader__.mode==='live' && __DSH_FORGE_CLIENT__; RPC probe window.dshForge.invoke; UI probes data-dswf-phase / bridgeDispatch via __DSH_FORGE_WORKBENCH__; onboarding neutralizer via DSH_FORGE_PATCH_FILES; dsh session log probe session.v3.jsonl.zstd under {dshHome}/sessions; NO fault-injection facility in e2e yet

subject: App state layer SQLite tables (single handle, WAL)
value: state.db at {app-data}/dsh-forge/state.db, SCHEMA_VERSION 1; projects (id PK, workspace_id NOT NULL UNIQUE, ws_path UNIQUE idx, name, forge_dir, forge_dir_external CHECK 0/1, knowledge_dir, archived, timestamps); knowledge_entries (derived cache, UNIQUE(project_id, rel_path)); knowledge_recall_logs (append-only SoT); app_key_logs (level warn|error, scope compensation|reconcile|index|recall); schema_meta
